description: Oppo K15 Pro and Oppo K15 Pro+ will be launched in India in the third quarter of this year, a tipster claims. The two handsets are also expected to debut in the country with the same specifications as their Chinese counterparts. This comes days after the Oppo K15 Pro series was launched in India. Both smartphones are equipped with built-in active cooling fans for thermal management, helping them avoid overheating during gaming and other resource-intensive tasks. The Oppo K15 Pro series carries a dual rear camera unit.
title: Oppo K15 Pro Series India Launch Timeline Tipped; Could Arrive With the Same Features as the Chinese Variant

description: A new Narzo smartphone from Realme has appeared on an Amazon microsite, pointing to an upcoming budget 5G launch in India. The listing includes an illustrated teaser that hints at the phone’s rear design, including a triple camera layout. References to the Narzo 80 Lite 5G suggest this could be its follow-up model. While the official name remains unconfirmed, it is likely to be part of the Narzo 90 lineup. Key specifications and launch details are still under wraps.
title: Realme Teases New Narzo Phone on Amazon, Launch Expected Soon

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 series was launched globally in February, and it could be joined by another model soon. The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, which has yet to be announced by the brand, has been spotted on a benchmarking site. The listing reveals the smartphone’s moniker, along with some of its key specifications. The purported Samsung handset is expected to arrive with a proprietary Exynos chipset and run Android 17.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Surfaces on Geekbench With Exynos 2500 Chip, Android 17

description: Google Vids, the company’s artificial intelligence (AI)-powered video creation platform, has received a massive update. In August 2025, the Mountain View-based tech giant expanded the platform to all users, but the ability to generate AI videos from text prompts was kept limited to paying subscribers. However, on Thursday, the company announced that everyone can now generate Veo 3.1-powered AI videos for free.
title: Google Vids Will Now Let All Users Generate Veo 3.1 AI Videos for Free, New Features Added

description: Crypto hackers stole $168.6 million in Q1 2026, marking a sharp drop from last year’s record losses. Data from DeFiLlama shows that most exploits targeted DeFi protocols, with compromised admin accounts and price manipulation dominating attack methods. Despite the decline, experts warn that risks remain as cybercriminal activity continues to follow market cycles.
title: Crypto Hack Losses Drop to $168.6 Million in Q1 2026 Despite Ongoing Risks

description: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Flip 8 are likely to launch later this year. While we wait for the formal reveal, a leak suggests that Samsung will use the M13 OLED material for these devices, marking the third consecutive year of using the same display technology. The M13 first appeared on the Galaxy Z Flip 6 and Galaxy Z Fold 6 in 2024. This decision is surprising as the Galaxy S26 Ultra has used the newer M14 material.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Flip 8 to Stick With Older M13 OLED Panels: Report

description: A new report has revealed design and feature details of the Infinix GT 50 Pro ahead of its expected launch. The phone may retain a hypercar-inspired look with added textures and a visible cooling design. It is tipped to include dual-pressure shoulder triggers, custom controls, and fast response times. The device could also use a micro-pump cooling system and support a MagCharge 2.0 accessory. Earlier leaks suggest a 144Hz AMOLED display, Dimensity chipset, and a possible India launch.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro Leak Shows Design, Cooling, Gaming Features Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Microsoft’s AI chief has reportedly set his eyes on developing cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) models by 2027. As per the report, the executive wants the Redmond-based tech giant to become self-sustaining in the AI space and handle all the different layers of the technology, from consumer-end implementation to development of foundational models, in-house.
title: Microsoft AI Chief Wants to Deliver State-of-the-Art AI Models by 2027: Report

description: Honor has started teasing the launch of a new smartphone, which will be unveiled in select global markets soon. Tech reviewer and YouTuber Sahil Karoul claims that the teaser belongs to the upcoming Honor 600 series, which is expected to include the Honor 600 and Honor 600 Pro. The two handsets are tipped to be launched later this month. However, the tech firm has yet to confirm these details. The phone is teased to arrive in at least an orange colour option. It could carry a triple rear camera unit.
title: Honor 600 Series Could Launch Soon as Company Starts Teasing Debut of a New Phone

description: Circle has introduced cirBTC, a token designed to bring Bitcoin into DeFi ecosystems with 1:1 backing and on-chain verifiability. The offering aims to address trust issues linked to traditional wrapped tokens while enabling lending, liquidity, and yield opportunities. As the rollout progresses, market participants will track adoption and performance across DeFi platforms.
title: Circle Unveils cirBTC Token to Expand Bitcoin’s Role in DeFi Ecosystem

description: Historically, emulator developers have largely prioritised Adreno GPUs, which has often resulted in limited support for the unique architectures found in Pixel devices. The latest emulator release closes this gap by introducing initial support for the Pixel 10's PowerVR GPU. This development finally enables Pixel users to run titles from the Steam storefront on their handsets more reliably, addressing the compatibility issues that previously left these models out of the equation.
title: Google Pixel 10 Users Can Now Play Steam Games Offline via GameNative 0.9.0

description: Redmi K Pad 2 and new laptops are said to launch alongside the Redmi K90 Ultra later this month. The tablet is said to come with an LCD panel. The upcoming laptop could be launched in both 14-inch and 16-inch display options. It could run on an Intel Core Ultra X7 358H processor, paired with up to 32GB of RAM and 1TB of storage. There is likely to be more models with Intel Core Ultra 5 338H and Core Ultra 5 325 chips.
title: Redmi K Pad 2, New Redmi Laptops Tipped to Launch Alongside Redmi K90 Ultra

description: Microsoft released three specialised artificial intelligence (AI) models on Thursday, focusing on image generation, voice generation, and speech-to-text transcription. The Redmond-based tech giant claims that these models outperform specialised models from rival companies, such as Google, OpenAI, and others. The models, MAI-Transcribe-1, MAI-Voice-1, and MAI-Image-2, are also said to focus on fast generation and competitive pricing.
title: Microsoft Releases New AI Models That Can Generate Images, Audio and Transcribe Text

description: Sale of the Vivo X300 Ultra will start in Austria on April 24. As we wait for the launch, a new leak suggests the Vivo X300 Ultra may launch in Europe at around Eur 1,900, slightly lower than the previously rumoured price tag of Eur 1,999. The handset bundled with a teleconverter kit could cost about EUR 2,300. European customers of the Vivo X300 Ultra will benefit from pre-order discounts.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Leak Reveals European Pricing; Said to Cost Less Than Expected

description: The IMF says tokenisation could improve efficiency in financial markets but warns it also introduces new risks. In its latest report, the organisation highlighted concerns around financial stability, legal clarity, and regulatory oversight. As adoption grows, the IMF stressed the need for strong frameworks to manage vulnerabilities while supporting innovation in blockchain-based financial systems.
title: IMF Says Tokenisation Could Transform Finance but Warns of New Risks

description: Google, on Thursday, introduced Gemma 4 artificial intelligence (AI) model. The first in the Gemma 4 family comes with several improvements over its predecessors. While Gemma 3 focused on text and visual reasoning capabilities, the Mountain View-based tech giant says the latest iteration brings agentic capabilities and advanced reasoning to the open-source model.
title: Google Introduces Gemma 4 Open-Source AI Model, Enables Building Autonomous Agents

description: Oppo is expected to launch the Find X9s Pro and Find X9 Ultra in China later this month, with only the Ultra confirmed for global release. Recent leaks from tipster Digital Chat Station reveal key details about both devices. The Find X9s Pro may feature a 6.32-inch 1.5K display, dual 200-megapixel cameras, and a 7,025mAh battery with fast charging support. Meanwhile, the Find X9 Ultra is tipped to offer a larger 2K display, similar battery capacity, and multiple colour options.
title: Oppo Find X9s Pro, Find X9 Ultra Key Features, Colour Options Leaked Ahead of April 21 Launch

description: The Oppo Find X9 Ultra is scheduled to be launched later this month. It will be unveiled in China and the global markets on the same day. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a recently surfaced image of the upcoming handset provides a closer look at the redesigned rear panel and its overall design. Separately, a tipster has leaked battery and charging specifications of the Find X9 Ultra.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Leaked Image Reveals Design; Tipped to Feature 7,050mAh Battery

description: Vivo T5 Pro 5G is now confirmed to launch in India soon, the China-based tech firm announced on Friday. A dedicated microsite for the handset is now live on Flipkart, confirming its availability in India via the e-commerce platform. The Vivo T5 Pro 5G is confirmed to feature a 9,020mAh battery and support up to 120 fps gaming. Moreover, it will carry a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a pill-shaped camera module. The company claims that the Vivo T5 Pro 5G will be the slimmest phone with a 9,020mAh cell.
title: Vivo T5 Pro 5G India Launch Teased Along With Availability Details, Key Specifications

description: Redmi 15A 5G is now available for purchase in India. The new Redmi A series smartphone was launched in the country last week with a 6,300mAh battery and a dual rear camera unit headlined by a 32-megapixel main camera. It flaunts a 6.9-inch display with up to 120Hz refresh rate. It has a Unisoc T8300 5G SoC under the hood. The new phone is available to purchase via the company's India Website and Flipkart in three colour options.
title: Redmi 15A 5G Goes on Sale in India for the First Time: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin traded near $66,500 on April 3 as markets remained stable despite mixed technical and institutional signals. Analysts highlighted a narrow trading range, with inconsistent ETF flows and weak derivatives activity limiting momentum. Altcoins showed selective gains, while broader sentiment stayed cautious. Experts said the market is in a consolidation phase, awaiting stronger directional triggers.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $66,500 as Market Holds Steady Amid Mixed Signals

description: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G will be equipped with a 50-megapixel primary camera on the back, according to a report. If this is true, then the Galaxy A series handset might arrive with a similar camera setup to the Samsung Galaxy A26 5G, which was launched in India in March 2025. However, the rumoured Galaxy A27 5G is also expected to sport a 12-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls, instead of the 13-megapixel selfie shooter on its predecessor. This comes soon after the handset was spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with a Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G Will Reportedly Launch With a Similar Camera Configuration to Its Predecessor

description: Google is said to be working on a new way to further refine notifications on Android. According to a report, references to a feature dubbed Notification Rules were spotted in Android 17 Beta 3. The system will reportedly provide users with more granular control over notifications from apps and individual contacts, moving beyond existing app-level controls. It is expected to build upon existing features like Notification Channels, Modes, and the recently introduced Notification Organiser.
title: Android 17 Beta 3 Update to Bring Notification Rules With Granular Control for Apps, Contacts: Report

description: Honor Play 80 is currently listed on Honor China website in four RAM and storage options. The new Play series phone runs on the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and has a 13-megapixel rear camera unit. It carries a 5,300mAh battery. It is listed in Azure Sky, Lake Blue, and Inky Black Rock colour options. It has a 6.75-inch full-HD+ display with a 90Hz refresh rate and includes a 5-megapixel front-facing camera.
title: Honor Play 80 Listed Online With MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC, 5,300mAh Battery

description: Apple’s latest AirTag 2 firmware, version 3.0.45, introduces changes to its safety alerts, particularly how the device signals the presence of an unfamiliar tracker. The updated audio cue is intended to help users identify and locate such devices more effectively through Precision Finding. The release also includes general system fixes. It is delivered automatically when the AirTag is within range of an iPhone. In India, the device is sold at Rs. 3,790, while a four-pack costs Rs. 12,900.
title: Apple Rolls Out AirTag 2 Firmware Update With Enhanced Tracking Alerts

description: NASA made history on Wednesday after successfully launching the Artemis 2 mission, which is carrying four astronauts to a lunar flyby. This is the first time in the 21st century that NASA has attempted a crewed mission, more than 50 years after the Apollo 17 mission in 1972. During the initial phase, the spacecraft flew around Earth a couple of times to build up momentum.
title: Artemis 2: Astronauts Aboard Orion Spacecraft Begin Journey Towards the Moon on Day 2

description: Motorola has added four more models to the list of phones that are eligible to receive the Android 17 beta updates. Now, Motorola Razr 60 Ultra users in India, Brazil, Latin America, and the EMEA regions can enrol in Motorola’s Android 17 Beta Programme. Moreover, Motorola Signature users in Brazil, Latin America, and EMEA, Motorola Razr Ultra (2025) users in the US, and Motorola Edge 60 Pro owners in India, Brazil, Latin America, and EMEA can also register to receive future Android 17 beta versions. The tech firm will alert the users when the update is available for their devices.
title: Motorola Signature, Razr 60 Ultra and More Models Now Eligible to Receive Android 17 Beta Updates

description: OpenAI is currently working on several UI updates that could eventually hit the ChatGPT app. An APK teardown of the ChatGPT app reportedly indicates the custom share sheet and file picker interface. OpenAI is working on an Uploaded files option as well. When you tap on this option, it will show a new window titled “Files in this chat.” This page will contain all the files users have previously uploaded.
title: ChatGPT App May Soon Get a Custom Share Sheet, File Picker Interface and More UI Changes

description: ChatGPT is rolling out to Apple CarPlay, allowing iPhone users on iOS 26.4 or later to interact with the assistant through voice while driving. The feature supports starting new chats, continuing recent conversations, and working within projects directly from the car interface. It can also launch automatically in voice mode. However, it does not access navigation, vehicle data, or other apps. Apple also integrates ChatGPT into Apple Intelligence features like Siri, Writing Tools, and visual search, with privacy controls and optional account sign-in.
title: OpenAI Brings ChatGPT to Apple CarPlay, but It Cannot Access Navigation and Live Location Data
Samsung Galaxy A57 5G: Smart Choice That Redefines Mid-Range Value

description: As Apple turns 50, Apple Authorised Reseller Imagine Store has announced a range of limited-period offers on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch models in India. The sale brings down the effective prices of several premium products in the Cupertino-based tech giant’s lineup through a mix of instant discounts, bank cashback, and exchange bonus options. The iPhone 17 Pro Max is available at a significantly reduced effective price, alongside offers on the iPhone 17, iPad (2025), and various Apple Watch models.
title: iPhone 17 Pro Max At Rs. 1,02,900 in Apple 50th Anniversary Sale; iPad, Watch Available With Offers
Everything You Use, Already Works on Snapdragon X Series Platforms

description: The upcoming Google Pixel 11 series has already surfaced in leaks earlier this week. Now renders of the top-end Google Pixel 11 Pro XL have appeared online in a report. The visuals provide a clearer look at the design of the model with the largest screen in the lineup. The purported handset appears to closely follow the design language earlier seen on the Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro models.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL Leaked CAD Renders Reveal Design Identical to Pixel 10 Pro XL
